name: Tooltip
blurb: A short label that appears on hover or focus.
mechanism: A ::after pseudo-element reading content from data-tip, shown on :hover and :focus-visible. No wrapper, no positioning library, no JavaScript - and no element in the DOM to forget to hide.
caveats: A pseudo-element cannot be described by aria-describedby, so the tip is invisible to screen readers. Put the same words in aria-label (or visible text) - the tooltip is a convenience for sighted mouse users, not the only copy.
Touch has no hover: on a phone the tip appears only if the control takes focus. Never hide anything essential in here.
It cannot escape an ancestor with overflow: hidden. Inside a scrolling panel, use a popover instead.
